symptom: PC in VLAN 30 gets IP but cannot reach server in same VLAN.
topology_note: Access switch SW1 connects PC3 on Fa0/12 and server on Fa0/20.
show_outputs: show vlan brief: VLAN 30 missing Fa0/12; Fa0/12 listed in VLAN 1 | show interfaces fa0/12 switchport: Access Mode VLAN: 1
expected_fault: PC access port is in the wrong VLAN.
expected_fix: Set Fa0/12 to access VLAN 30 and verify with show vlan brief.

symptom: VLAN 20 users cannot reach the router subinterface; VLAN 10 works.
topology_note: SW1 trunk Gi0/1 connects to R1 router-on-a-stick.
show_outputs: show interfaces trunk: Gi0/1 allowed vlans 1,10,30 | show ip interface brief: Gi0/1.20 up/up 192.168.20.1
expected_fault: VLAN 20 is not allowed on the trunk.
expected_fix: Add VLAN 20 to the trunk allowed list.

symptom: PC receives 192.168.10.25/24 but cannot reach other networks.
topology_note: Default gateway should be R1 Gi0/0.10 at 192.168.10.1.
show_outputs: ipconfig: IPv4 192.168.10.25 Mask 255.255.255.0 Gateway 192.168.10.254 | show ip int brief: Gi0/0.10 192.168.10.1 up/up
expected_fault: Client has the wrong default gateway.
expected_fix: Correct the DHCP default-router option or static gateway to 192.168.10.1.

symptom: PC can ping local printer but not the internet.
topology_note: Small office LAN uses 10.10.5.0/24 with gateway 10.10.5.1.
show_outputs: ipconfig: IPv4 10.10.5.44 Mask 255.255.255.0 Gateway 10.10.6.1 | show ip route: C 10.10.5.0/24 is directly connected
expected_fault: Gateway is outside the client subnet.
expected_fix: Set gateway to 10.10.5.1.

symptom: New PCs get APIPA addresses in VLAN 40.
topology_note: R1 is DHCP server for VLAN 40.
show_outputs: show ip dhcp pool VLAN40: Network 192.168.40.0/24 Default-router 192.168.40.1 | show ip dhcp binding: none | show run interface gi0/0.40: encapsulation dot1q 40 ip address 192.168.40.1 255.255.255.0
expected_fault: DHCP service is disabled or requests are not reaching the server.
expected_fix: Enable DHCP service and verify relay/trunk path.

symptom: Remote VLAN 50 clients do not get addresses from central DHCP server.
topology_note: DHCP server is 172.16.0.10 behind router HQ.
show_outputs: show run interface vlan50: ip address 192.168.50.1 255.255.255.0 no ip helper-address | show ip dhcp server statistics: 0 messages received
expected_fault: Missing DHCP relay helper on VLAN 50 gateway.
expected_fix: Add ip helper-address 172.16.0.10 on the VLAN 50 gateway interface.

symptom: VLAN 60 clients receive addresses but cannot ping gateway.
show_outputs: show ip dhcp binding: 192.168.6.21 assigned | show ip dhcp pool: Network 192.168.6.0/24 Default-router 192.168.60.1
expected_fault: DHCP pool network is wrong.
expected_fix: Change the pool network to 192.168.60.0/24.

symptom: Users can ping 8.8.8.8 but cannot open example.com.
topology_note: Branch PCs use DHCP.
show_outputs: ipconfig /all: DNS Servers 192.168.99.99 | nslookup example.com: DNS request timed out | ping 8.8.8.8 succeeds
expected_fault: Incorrect DNS server assigned to clients.
expected_fix: Update DHCP DNS option to a reachable DNS server.

symptom: Only app.corp.local fails; other DNS names resolve.
topology_note: Internal DNS server hosts corp.local zone.
show_outputs: nslookup app.corp.local: Non-existent domain | nslookup web.corp.local: 10.1.1.20
expected_fault: Missing or incorrect DNS A record.
expected_fix: Add or correct the app.corp.local A record.

symptom: Branch LAN can reach its router but not HQ server 10.0.10.10.
topology_note: R2 connects branch 192.168.20.0/24 to HQ through R1.
show_outputs: show ip route on R2: no route to 10.0.10.0/24 | ping 10.0.10.10 source 192.168.20.1 fails
expected_fault: R2 lacks a route to the HQ subnet.
expected_fix: Add a static route or dynamic routing entry toward R1.

symptom: Branch has a static route to HQ but traffic still fails.
topology_note: R2 next hop to R1 should be 172.16.12.1.
show_outputs: show ip route: S 10.0.10.0/24 [1/0] via 172.16.21.1 | show cdp neighbors: R1 on 172.16.12.1 link
expected_fault: Static route uses the wrong next hop.
expected_fix: Replace the route with next hop 172.16.12.1.

symptom: OSPF neighbors form on WAN but LAN route is missing at HQ.
topology_note: R2 advertises branch LAN through OSPF.
show_outputs: show ip ospf interface brief: Gi0/1 passive | show ip route ospf on R1: no 192.168.20.0/24
expected_fault: OSPF is not advertising the branch LAN.
expected_fix: Correct OSPF network statements/passive settings for the LAN.

symptom: VLAN 30 can ping gateway but cannot reach server TCP 80.
topology_note: ACL applied inbound on router subinterface.
show_outputs: show access-lists: 10 deny tcp 192.168.30.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.0.10.20 eq 80 | show ip interface gi0/0.30: inbound access list is 10
expected_fault: ACL blocks HTTP from VLAN 30.
expected_fix: Modify ACL to permit required HTTP traffic.

symptom: Only one permitted subnet can cross router; all others fail unexpectedly.
topology_note: ACL 101 was added for testing.
show_outputs: show access-lists 101: permit ip 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 any | show ip interface gi0/0: outbound access list is 101
expected_fault: ACL is missing needed permit statements, causing implicit deny.
expected_fix: Add explicit permits for required subnets or remove the ACL.

symptom: Guest network can access internal server despite deny rule.
topology_note: ACL was intended to protect 10.0.10.0/24.
show_outputs: show access-lists GUEST-BLOCK: deny ip 192.168.99.0 0.0.0.255 10.0.10.0 0.0.0.255 permit ip any any | show ip interface gi0/1: outbound access list is not set; inbound access list is not set
expected_fault: ACL exists but is not applied to the interface/direction.
expected_fix: Apply the ACL on the guest interface in the correct direction.

symptom: Inside users can ping router outside interface but not the internet.
topology_note: R1 performs NAT overload to ISP.
show_outputs: show ip nat translations: empty | show run: ip nat inside source list 1 interface s0/0/0 overload; access-list 1 permit 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255 | inside LAN is 192.168.10.0/24
expected_fault: NAT ACL does not match the inside subnet.
expected_fix: Change NAT ACL to permit 192.168.10.0/24.

symptom: NAT configured but translations never appear.
topology_note: R1 LAN Gi0/0, ISP S0/0/0.
show_outputs: show run int gi0/0: no ip nat inside | show run int s0/0/0: ip nat outside
expected_fault: Inside NAT role missing on LAN interface.
expected_fix: Configure ip nat inside on the LAN interface.

symptom: External users cannot reach internal web server.
topology_note: Server 192.168.10.50 should publish as 203.0.113.50.
show_outputs: show ip nat translations: --- 203.0.113.50 192.168.10.5 --- --- | show arp: 192.168.10.50 reachable
expected_fault: Static NAT maps the public IP to the wrong private host.
expected_fix: Correct static NAT mapping to 192.168.10.50.

symptom: Laptop cannot join corporate Wi-Fi.
topology_note: WLC WLAN name should be CORP.
show_outputs: client status: SSID CORP-NET not found | wlan summary: WLAN 1 SSID CORP enabled
expected_fault: Client is using the wrong SSID.
expected_fix: Configure the client to join SSID CORP.

symptom: Laptop sees SSID but authentication fails.
topology_note: Pre-shared key was changed during maintenance.
show_outputs: client log: WPA authentication failed | WLC WLAN security: WPA2-PSK enabled
expected_fault: Incorrect wireless pre-shared key on client or WLAN.
expected_fix: Set matching WPA2-PSK on the client and WLAN.

symptom: Wireless clients connect but get addresses from the wrong subnet.
topology_note: CORP WLAN should map to VLAN 20.
show_outputs: show wlan summary: CORP interface guest_vlan | ipconfig: 192.168.99.18 gateway 192.168.99.1
expected_fault: WLAN is mapped to the wrong VLAN/interface.
expected_fix: Map CORP WLAN to the VLAN 20 interface.

symptom: New sales PCs in VLAN 70 are down at Layer 2.
topology_note: SW2 was configured with access vlan 70 on ports.
show_outputs: show vlan brief: VLAN 70 not listed | show interfaces fa0/5 switchport: Access Mode VLAN: 70 inactive
expected_fault: Access VLAN does not exist on the switch.
expected_fix: Create VLAN 70 and name it appropriately.

symptom: Site-to-site routing failed after cable move.
topology_note: WAN link between R1 and R2.
show_outputs: show ip interface brief: Serial0/0/0 administratively down | show controllers serial0/0/0: DCE cable
expected_fault: WAN interface is shut down.
expected_fix: Issue no shutdown and configure clock rate if required.

symptom: PC can reach some local hosts but not all hosts in the expected subnet.
topology_note: LAN should be 172.16.4.0/23.
expected_fault: Client subnet mask is too narrow.

symptom: Only the newest lab PCs fail to get DHCP addresses.
topology_note: Small DHCP pool was created for 10 test devices.
show_outputs: show ip dhcp pool LAB: Leased addresses 10; total addresses 10; excluded 192.168.80.1-192.168.80.244
expected_fault: DHCP pool is exhausted.
expected_fix: Increase the available address range or reduce exclusions.

symptom: Browser fails by name, but pinging the web server IP works.
topology_note: DHCP options were recently edited.
show_outputs: ipconfig /all: Default Gateway 192.168.10.1 DNS Servers 192.168.10.1 | show hosts on router: no DNS records
expected_fault: Clients use the router as DNS when it is not providing DNS service.
expected_fix: Set DHCP DNS option to the actual DNS server.

symptom: SSH to switch management fails from admin PC; ping works.
topology_note: Management ACL controls VTY access.
show_outputs: show access-lists MGMT: deny tcp host 192.168.10.25 any eq 22 permit ip any any | show run line vty: access-class MGMT in
expected_fault: Management ACL denies SSH from admin PC.
expected_fix: Permit the admin PC for SSH or correct the ACL order.

symptom: Inside users have NAT translations but no internet response.
topology_note: R1 connects to ISP on S0/0/0.
show_outputs: show ip nat translations: icmp 203.0.113.2:4 192.168.10.25:4 8.8.8.8:4 8.8.8.8:4 | show ip route: Gateway of last resort is not set
expected_fault: Default route to ISP is missing.
expected_fix: Add a default route toward the ISP next hop.

symptom: Intermittent connectivity and CDP native VLAN warnings.
topology_note: SW1 and SW2 trunk over Gi0/1.
show_outputs: show interfaces trunk: SW1 native vlan 99; SW2 native vlan 1 | CDP-4-NATIVE_VLAN_MISMATCH on Gi0/1
expected_fault: Native VLAN mismatch on trunk.
expected_fix: Set matching native VLAN on both trunk ends.

symptom: Wireless clients cannot see any SSIDs near AP1.
topology_note: AP1 was powered but no clients associate.
show_outputs: show ap summary: AP1 registered; Radio 2.4GHz Disabled Radio 5GHz Disabled
expected_fault: AP radios are disabled.
expected_fix: Enable required AP radios.

symptom: Gateway flaps and ARP table changes repeatedly.
topology_note: Two router interfaces were copied from the same template.
show_outputs: show ip interface brief: R1 Gi0/0 192.168.10.1 up/up; R2 Gi0/0 192.168.10.1 up/up | arp entries change between MAC addresses
expected_fault: Duplicate IP address on gateway interfaces.
expected_fix: Assign unique IP addresses and update clients if needed.

symptom: One access switch loses VLAN 10 reachability through redundant links.
topology_note: STP protects redundant topology.
show_outputs: show spanning-tree vlan 10: Gi0/2 Altn BLK | intended uplink Gi0/1 forwarding
expected_fault: Traffic expected on a blocked STP path due to wrong uplink assumption.
expected_fix: Use the forwarding uplink or adjust STP priority/design intentionally.
